_comment: Extensible config for AI SQL agent. Add tables/columns here when schema changes. Run scripts/refresh_schema_for_ai.py after adding DB tables.

column_semantic_hints.NETWR: Net value / amount – use for sales, costs, revenue aggregation (SUM)
column_semantic_hints.MATNR: Material number – join to MAKT for product names
column_semantic_hints.KUNNR: Customer number – join to KNA1 for customer details
column_semantic_hints.LIFNR: Vendor number – join to LFA1 for vendor names
column_semantic_hints.VBELN: Document number – common join key (billing, delivery, sales)
column_semantic_hints.EBELN: Purchase order number – join key for EKKO/EKPO
column_semantic_hints.FKDAT: Billing date (YYYYMMDD) – for sales date filters
column_semantic_hints.BUDAT: Posting date (YYYYMMDD) – for vendor invoice date filters
column_semantic_hints.BEDAT: Purchasing document date (YYYYMMDD) – for PO date filters
column_semantic_hints.MAKTX: Material description – use for product labels
column_semantic_hints.BRSCH: Industry code – join T016T for industry name
column_semantic_hints.BRTXT: Industry description – use for industry labels

table_semantic_hints.VBRP: Billing document item – sales by product, amounts, quantities. Join VBRK for header, KNA1 for customer.
table_semantic_hints.vbrp: Same as VBRP – billing item for sales analysis.
table_semantic_hints.VBRK: Billing document header – invoice dates, customer (KUNAG), currency.
table_semantic_hints.KNA1: Customer master – names, country (LAND1), industry (brsch). Use T016T for industry text.
table_semantic_hints.MAKT: Material descriptions – MAKTX for product names. Join on MATNR.
table_semantic_hints.T016T: Industry descriptions – BRTXT for industry names. Join KNA1.brsch = T016T.brsch.
table_semantic_hints.EKKO: Purchase order header – vendor (LIFNR), dates (BEDAT), currency.
table_semantic_hints.EKPO: Purchase order item – amounts (NETWR), quantities, materials.
table_semantic_hints.RBKP: Vendor invoice header – vendor (LIFNR), amount (RMWWR), date (BUDAT).
table_semantic_hints.RSEG: Vendor invoice item – amounts (WRBTR, DMBTR), quantities.
table_semantic_hints.LIKP: Outbound delivery header – delivery documents, ship-to.
table_semantic_hints.VBAK: Sales order header – customer, order dates.
table_semantic_hints.VBAP: Sales order item – products, quantities, values.
table_semantic_hints.BSAD: Customer cleared items – AR line items, amounts (DMBTR, WRBTR).
table_semantic_hints.BSEG: Accounting document segment – amounts, customers, vendors.
